FIVE confirmed actions: SHIELD -> TRANSFER -> UNSHIELD -> zero-value-dummy TRANSFER (out 400+20+0) -> the zero note SPENT as an in-note (out 200+100+100); every input VM-ACCEPTED consensus+standard. The Nito client 3-out witness path is built and byte-exact against the live UNSHIELD; the store branch is wired (poolId + outs=3). 3-out BLANKS are now permissionless (vending loaded, first stranger buy confirmed 2026-11-26). Still open: the Nito UI pool selector and the browser acceptance (walletProverCompatible stays false until it passes).

knownFindings.status: PROVEN 2026-11-26, NOT executed on chain (proof /home/apecs/cov/role2-probe-nullifier-doubling-3out.json on apecsdev, snarkjs verify OK against the deployed VK d4ed12ee...; not committed)
knownFindings.mechanism: neither circuit constrains the two in-notes distinct; hook check 7 folds SHA256(oldNull||nf0||nf1) with no membership test; nPublic 2 means oldNull is not verifiable by the circuit. A single note loads as BOTH in-notes and its value counts twice.
knownFindings.impact: this pool's whole 700 FT drains in 3 actions ([112,112]->224 -> [224,224]->448 -> [448,448] UNSHIELD 700). The 2-out pool drains in ONE action (see its entry).
knownFindings.fix: the v3 nullifier set (docs/ROLE2-3OUT-V3-DESIGN.md section 3.2) with membership proofs + hook check; measure the SMT depth before any ceremony.
knownFindings.standingRule: NO valued asset may enter any pool running the current hook; Gate 7 is not the only mainnet gate - the nullifier set is.
